## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Review ID and round: design-review-r6, independent exact Design/adoption reassessment.
- Package: Design, System, Workflow and retained Target-native init at the four stored current subjects.
- Supporting adoption basis: exact Constitution/AGENTS, four retained consumer notices, boundary mapping references, historical method spec/test, mixed system architecture, retained ADRs and FU-012–014 listed below.
- Upstream direction: unchanged accepted proposal and independent proposal-review.
- Findings: no new material Design/adoption findings; all prior Design findings retain resolved disposition and original history.
- Recording status: targeted v2 review/evidence batch.
- Applicability: current only for this exact Design package and inspected adoption-document basis.
- Next owner: Route; no activity/work/plan edits by reviewer.
- Claim limits: this assesses contract coherence and source-authority disposition, not M2 implementation, whole-change Code Review, successful Verify, release or customer adoption.

## Exact change and authority judgment

The complete earlier four-member Design assessment is retained with affirmative identity/diff evidence. System and Workflow are byte-identical. Design changes only the transition-description sentences: unified design supplies authoring at coordinated adoption, and the installer must retain original-basis authority rather than a mutable not-yet-implemented statement. All20 DES-SR rows and intended outcomes remain unchanged. Target-native init relabels its old top-level Status as Historical approval and states the original approval fact; all remaining source text, including scoped TNI-DES and the original historical body, is unchanged. No old assessment is retargeted. Fresh approval is attached to these revised exact subjects, while r5 remains historical/stale.

Constitution/AGENTS select owning Designs for adopted responsibilities and retain feature/architecture/ADR contracts for unmigrated responsibilities. Combined behavioral/technical authorship and exact independent review replace the selected normal tuple without merging Proposal, Delivery, implementation, Review/Test policy or Verify. Governance remains superior to component/System prose; installation grants no customer adoption. The notices expressly condition the selected transfer on reviewed implementation and successful Verify, so this review does not claim adoption completion in advance.

## Grandfathered-source classifications

- skill-contract: adopted-profile owner/invocation reference and equivalent example-path updates; existing resource-mapping, parity and clean-install expected outcomes remain. No new historical feature behavior is authored.
- rigorloop-workflow: adopted-profile unified author/exact-review-subject reference; historical protocol/record/lifecycle identities retain meaning.
- skill-invocation-commands-for-adapters: selected adopted-profile authoring inventory/alias reference; unrelated target/invocation contract remains.
- multi-adapter-init-and-proxy-aware-download: reference to already reviewed TNI-DES owner/procedure; archive trust, root/state protection and other local behavior remain owned there and unchanged.
- boundary-first-proof-model: owner link/label changes only; retained feature-format serialization and PBF-R049b observation behavior remain.
- target-native-init: only historical approval presentation changed since r5; substantive TNI-DES amendment remains under its reviewed boundary-first-v1 record.

These are independently assessed adopted-profile/reference or non-substantive historical clarifications, not new unmarked feature behavior requiring retrospective conversion. Required current semantics are already owned by the four-member reviewed package. The classification does not turn structural success or review_required observations into approval mechanically.

## MW-02 preservation and bounded retirement

The numbered R1–R124 map is complete and unique, and the independent assessment also traced its substance and unnumbered model/example safeguards, decisions and selected mixed-System sections. The full method spec/test bodies remain unchanged below their new historical notices; old IDs, acceptance examples and approval references preserve their old meaning. Both method ADR files are byte-identical. Current navigation summaries point to Design decision preservation rather than claiming those ADRs approved new text.

Mixed system architecture edits follow the exact selected composition/method paragraphs, bullets, Level1 inventory, authoring flow and source/diagram/legacy handling sections. Unselected Level2, installation, distribution, validation and other details retain explicit existing owners/amendments. Section-level replacement mappings preserve navigation meaning without treating the entire mixed file as superseded. No repository-wide consolidation is claimed.

FU-012–014 are durable register assignments for skill/resource/validation architecture, installation/distribution/release models, and remaining feature/Level2/ADR/automation/observability/measurement inventory. Each names maintainer accountability, proposal-stage receiving ownership and the next inventory/proposal decision. Required present consumer reconciliation is not deferred with them. This satisfies the approved later-work boundary, not commissioning or completing those future migrations.

## Validation and limitations

MW-02 is recorded independently as mw-02-independent-preservation. Its complete checks/classifications/identities are retained in evidence summary, not only temporary logs or chat. Mechanical body/ID checks support the manual source-map judgment and do not prove semantics alone.

The supplied baseline/current boundary reports have exactly the same two BFR-NEW-SPEC-MARKER failures for architecture-package-method.md. Its complete preexisting body is now explicitly historical under the approved retirement, with no new active feature behavior introduced there. This finding concerns the existing structural classifier/activation baseline, not a missing normative boundary for the new living Design. The command remains failed evidence; this review does not label it passed, rewrite the activation grandfathering baseline, or grant a blanket waiver. Final Verify must assess the exact current authority scope and remaining failed evidence. Current additional grandfathered observations are dispositioned semantically above.

The prior13 historical installer prose errors remain preserved as reported baseline debt. Historical approval labeling is a bounded correction to artifact-state representation; no old approval body or judgment is rewritten. Actual installer execution, source/package test sufficiency and final candidate coherence belong to subsequent M2 Code Review and Verify. Current implementation evidence or a local package pass cannot substitute for them.

## Independence

Concrete independent nonauthor task /root/independent_design_review assessed the current exact four-member Design package and supporting adoption/governance notices. Primary-agent authored all reviewed production documentation. Reviewer performed source/diff/migration assessment and authored only review/evidence, not the governed contributions. Prior Design review and MW-01 supply retained bounded basis, not automatic approval.

## Exact inspected basis
